(opened by the member, not cited)
Sam — Robot Hand Integration and Manipulation said about it: The rigid core bolts to the fingertip holder with two M3 screws, where M3 means 3 millimetre metric screw, and carries the 139 N fingertip limit from the Hand-E Instruction Manual (E25) with 463 kPa worst-case pressure and 100 kPa at 30 N grip from the mount load vs grip and drop check (E32).
Sam — Robot Hand Integration and Manipulation said about it: Nominal grip is 30 N at 100 kPa over 300 mm squared, survival proof is 139 N at 463 kPa from the Hand-E Instruction Manual (E25) and the mount load versus grip check (E32), and normal work is 14.8 N for a 1 kg object at 5.00 m per s squared, which checks as a milk bottle against hanging a 14.2 kg bag for survival.
